notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.1.18873371
notes.content: [p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Power Bank[/b] had no effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]Family Portrait[/b] didn't check for white bills.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions[/b][/p][list][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated the background image for inactive [b]Challenge Room[/b] to make the hint more noticeable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more hints when trying to access a inactive [b]Challenge Room[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted receipt position when holding a stamp.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more key instructions to the Esc menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Bombs can now be canceled with E after being picked up.[/p][/*][*][p]Bombs now show target positions in four directions when held.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the description of [b]Bear Paw[/b] for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the icon for the Recovery stat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Angel/Devil Room[/b] chances are now guaranteed to appear daily.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed how starting items are displayed for characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated description for [b]Floor Stamps[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Floor Stamps[/b] can now be used normally inside rooms.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where [b]Power Bank[/b] had no effect.
Fixed a bug where [b]Family Portrait[/b] didn't check for white bills.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted receipt position when holding a stamp.

tags.feature: Added more key instructions to the Esc menu.
Bombs can now be canceled with E after being picked up.
